children: Regional banking company Western Alliance Bancorporation
will be reporting results this Monday afternoon. Here’s what to expect.

Western Alliance Bancorporation met analysts’ revenue expectations last quarter, reporting revenues of $986.3 million, up 18.2% year on year. It was a slower quarter for the company, with a significant miss of analysts’ EPS estimates and a slight miss of analysts’ net interest income estimates.
Is Western Alliance Bancorporation a buy or sell going into earnings?

params.linkText: Read our full analysis here, it’s free for active Edge members

children: This quarter, the market is expecting Western Alliance Bancorporation’s revenue to grow 7.3% year on year, slowing from the 13.3% increase it recorded in the same quarter last year.

Analysts covering the company have generally reconfirmed their estimates over the last 30 days, suggesting they anticipate the business will stay the course heading into earnings. Western Alliance Bancorporation has missed Wall Street’s revenue estimates multiple times over the last two years.

Looking at Western Alliance Bancorporation’s peers in the regional banks segment, some have already reported their Q3 results, giving us a hint as to what we can expect. Independent Bank delivered year-on-year revenue growth of 7.4%, beating analysts’ expectations by 0.6%, and Regions Financial reported revenues up 2.6%, topping estimates by 0.6%. Independent Bank traded up 3.6% following the results.

Over the last year or so, investors' attention has moved from one major market theme to the next, spanning AI disruption and surging infrastructure investment to geopolitical tensions, interest rates, and the health of the broader economy. While some of the regional banks stocks have shown solid performance in this choppy environment, the group has generally underperformed, with share prices down 5.1% on average over the last month. Western Alliance Bancorporation is down 4.8% during the same time and is heading into earnings with an average analyst price target of $90.56 (compared to the current share price of $74.75).
